text:
sarah: Customer reports debug bundle generation failing on Private deployment (air-gapped). Collector v1.2.3 starts, does redaction, then fails at presign step with 403. They see "signature mismatch" in our agent logs. Request ID they gave: req_20240321_84f2.
devin: Can you paste the collector stdout/stderr and the exact presign response body + request ID? Also which upload mode did they choose (s3 presign vs sftp)?
kevin: They chose presign -> S3. Quick paste from the customer:
kevin: ```
$ ./collector collect --debug --output debugbundle.tar.gz
...
2024-03-21T10:12:33Z INFO redact: applying redaction policy /etc/redact/policy.yaml
2024-03-21T10:12:34Z ERROR upload: presign failed status=403 body="{\"error\":\"signature mismatch\"}" request_id=req_20240321_84f2
2024-03-21T10:12:34Z ERROR main: exiting: upload failed
```
opsbot: Incident note: support-ticket #S-9082 created and linked. Escalation to eng requested.
alan: Thanks. Few quick checks we usually do: collector binary checksum, OS tz/clock skew, redaction plugin version, and that the collector's role/key has s3:PutObject+kms:Encrypt if using KMS signing. Can customer confirm collector sha256 and output of `./collector version`? Also need the presign URL (redacted host ok) to inspect query params.
sarah: I asked for the version + sha. Customer sent `collector v1.2.3 (sha: d4c3b2a)` and presign url snippet: `https://rw-support-s3.s3.amazonaws.com/support-debug-debugbundle.tar.gz?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Credential=...&X-Amz-Signature=...` (they redacted signature). They say direct PUT with that presigned URL works from their local machine, but the collector's attempt fails with 403. They tested `curl -v -X PUT --upload-file debugbundle.tar.gz "<presign-url>"` and it succeeded; collector still fails.
devin: That suggests collector is changing headers or signing something else. Common causes: adding `Content-MD5` or `x-amz-meta-*` headers after presign, or the collector's HTTP client sets `Expect: 100-continue` which some S3 endpoints don't like with certain proxies. Can we get a tcpdump of the collector's outbound request or the raw curl trace? Also check if the collector uses chunked transfer encoding — S3 presigned PUT expects exact content-length unless the presign was for streaming.
kevin: Customer ran strace and gave us POST raw headers (redacted):
kevin: ```
PUT /support-debug-debugbundle.tar.gz?X-Amz-Algorithm=... HTTP/1.1
Host: rw-support-s3.s3.amazonaws.com
User-Agent: collector/1.2.3
Content-Length: 1234567
Content-Type: application/x-tar
Expect: 100-continue
Accept: */*

<<DATA>>
```
alan: There it is — `Expect: 100-continue`. Our presign generation does not include that header in the canonical request; some intermediary (the customer's proxy) is rejecting the pre-signed signature because the server sees the `Expect` header and includes it for canonicalization. Two workarounds: 1) collector should not send `Expect` header for presigned PUTs (we can push a quick patch), 2) customer can disable `Expect` in their environment (set `GODEBUG=http2client=0` isn't relevant, but many http libs allow disabling `Expect`).
opsbot: Suggested action: create a debug build of collector without `Expect` header and ask customer to test. Assigning to @devin for a quick repro and patch; @alan please review redaction flow to ensure nothing else mutates headers post-presign.
sarah: Meanwhile customer asked for immediate upload path — they can fall back to SFTP. We gave them an sftp server earlier but their infra team wants to stay automated. Could we provide a manual presign-based PUT example that collector could call? They already tried curl and it worked.
devin: I'll repro locally by adding `Expect: 100-continue` to curl and see if we can get 403 vs success. If that reproduces, we can ship a collector patch which removes `Expect` for presigned uploads. Quick local test plan:

1) Generate presign URL via our private presign service: `POST /presign` -> get url
2) `curl -v -X PUT -H "Expect:" --upload-file debugbundle.tar.gz "<presign-url>"` (note empty Expect header to force removal)
3) `curl -v -X PUT --upload-file debugbundle.tar.gz -H "Expect: 100-continue" "<presign-url>"` (test with Expect)

alan: Also double-check redaction plugin doesn't add `x-redwood-redact` metadata header after presign. That would also break signature. If it needs metadata, we should include it at presign time and sign the presign with those headers.
kevin: Customer provided env details: running behind corporate proxy (transparent), collector runs in a systemd unit with `Environment=AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true`. They can toggle a debug collector build. They're ok to test tonight.
sarah: Okay plan:
- @devin: reproduce and validate `Expect` is the culprit; produce a 1-line patch to remove `Expect` header for presign uploads. ETA 3h.
- @alan: review redaction metadata path for header mutations; confirm no post-presign header additions. ETA 6h.
- @kevin (customer): run debug collector binary I will share via support ticket, collect logs (`--debug`) and try upload. If that fails, upload debugbundle.tar.gz manually via curl to the presign URL and attach success/failure traces.
devin: Repro notes (I'll paste test output here when done). If we need a rollback-safe quickfix, we can add an environment toggle `REDWOOD_DISABLE_EXPECT=1` to collector to avoid shipping a code change tonight.
kevin: I tested curl locally with `Expect: 100-continue` and the presign endpoint returned 403 (same signature mismatch). When I removed the header curl succeeded. So reproduction matches.
alan: OK that nails it. After @devin's patch we should push a patch to v1.2.4 and include a short changelog entry. Also update docs: private deployment collectors behind corporate proxies may need this disablement if proxies modify headers. I'll write a short note for the private deployment runbook.
opsbot: Update: support-ticket #S-9082 annotated with reproduction steps and assigned to dev@redwood. Priority: P2.
sarah: Final ask for customer: please run the debug collector binary with `REDWOOD_DISABLE_EXPECT=1 ./collector collect --debug --output debugbundle.tar.gz` and paste the collector logs if it still fails. If that succeeds, the collector will upload automatically; if not, please attach `debugbundle.tar.gz` via the manual curl PUT and paste the `curl -v` output.
kevin: Will try and report back in ~1h.
devin: I'll start the patch now and post a build to the ticket when ready. If needed we'll do a hotfix build we can drop into their environment.
